findings.body: The new attachment interface has no executable coverage. tests/test_chatview_start.py:29 lets the stub accept thread/attachment/add, but no test invokes codex.attach or exercises this driver branch. Removing the attachment implementation would leave the suite green. Add integration coverage through codex.attach and the real SDK driver, faking only the app-server, to verify the recorded thread, identity and payload, no request without a recorded conversation, and non-fatal request errors. This interface can be tested within START without waiting for ATTACH's forge close integration.
findings.title: Not done: attachment request tests
